notes: BiDi pair: SO-SFP28-BX40D-2731 (1270 nm Tx / 1310 nm Rx) and SO-SFP28-BX40D-3127 (1310 nm Tx / 1270 nm Rx). Power budget 10–18 dB stated in summary column. Dispersion penalty Max 2.7 dB listed without separate ps/nm tolerance. Tx/Rx powers and receiver levels are average power (footnote 3). Minimum input power and overload specified at 25GE and BER (footnote 4); overview states BER 5×10⁻⁵ for 25G Ethernet with FEC implemented in host equipment. Operating and storage temperature both -40°C to +85°C (I-temp). DDM per SFF-8472.
suggestions: Clarify whether footnote 4 BER is 5×10⁻⁵ only or also applies to CPRI opt 10; add explicit lane count and modulation if applicable; dispersion penalty 2.7 dB could be mapped if schema adds max dispersion penalty without full penalty object.
